outlook.statement: Expect India's capital markets to become deeper, more sophisticated and more central to household wealth building and corporate fundraising over the next decade; aim to strengthen core broking and advisory, build wealth and portfolio management as a second engine of growth, while preserving conservatism and governance.

India's financial ecosystem transformation - broadening investor base, deepening participation beyond largest cities, domestic capital pool increasingly financing India's growth - presents compounding opportunity for the firm.

The global economy is expected to settle into steadier, if unspectacular, growth of around 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027, driven by technology-led productivity and AI adoption spreading from software into industrial and healthcare applications.

India's structural headroom for asset gathering and advisory-led wealth management remains large, with financial asset penetration still low by developed market standards and continuing entry of Gen Z and millennial investors pointing to a multi-year runway.

Investment Banking team continues to build pipeline against backdrop of primary market that stayed structurally busy through FY26 (366 companies accessed IPO market); focused on converting pipeline into completed mandates as market sentiment stabilises
Asset Management - PMS segment sees clear medium-term opportunity to scale as platform matures, particularly among existing HNI broking and wealth management clients
Wealth Management segment positioned to benefit from expanding HNI/UHNI base, rising household allocation to financial assets, and industry shift toward advisory-led engagement
Structural deepening of retail participation (demat accounts past 22 crore) gives Equity Broking, Investor AI and DP businesses long structural runway
